ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الَّذِيْ مَا ضَلَّ عَنِ الْحَقِّ وَمَا غَوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī mā ḍalla `ani ‘l-haqqi wa mā ghawā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who never strayed from truth nor deviated!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَلْبِسْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ لِبَاسَ التَّقْوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, wa albisnā bi ‘ṣ-Ṣalāti `alayhi libāsa ‘t-taqwā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and clothe us by sending prayers upon him the garments of Allah-consciousness!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَطَهِّرْنَا بِهَا مِنَ الشَّكْوَى وَالدَّعْوَى .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa tahhirnā bi hā mina sh-shakwā wa ‘d-da`wā.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and purify us thereby from complaint and pretension!
